lines: Commits on track/p-web-version (not landed): 3dcc4e3 fix(web): revalidate index.html and offer Reload for a newer build; fccf097 fix(web): show one top banner at a time and space version checks (review-82 follow-up).
WHAT THE LANE DOES

- nginx.conf: index.html and the SPA fallback no-cache; /version.json no-cache (fccf097); /assets/ public, max-age=31536000, immutable with try_files $uri =404; / and /health unchanged. Host vhosts pass Cache-Control through (read, not edited).
- vite.config.ts: build-only plugin writes dist/version.json {version, target}.

- src/platform/webVersion.ts: tolerant comparison (current / replaced / unknown); watcher skipped for the Capacitor bridge and the https://localhost origin; checks on start, every 5 min while not hidden, and on focus/visibility unless the last check finished under 30 s ago (fccf097); one read in flight, 10 s abort, no-store; failures report nothing; the chain ends in a catch that logs (fccf097).

- src/app/native/WebVersionBanner.tsx: NOTICE_BANNER row with Reload; hidden while offline and, since fccf097, while the maintenance notice banner shows; Reload asks first when an admin held write is unsettled.
- AppProviders.tsx: import + mount after ConnectivityBanner.
REVIEW-82 FOLLOW-UP (fccf097)

- M1 fixed: the banner hides when !maintenance && readAppNotices(appConfig.config).maintenance !== null, the same rule AppNoticeGate uses. It reads the app-config query's cached data through useQueryClient + useSyncExternalStore on the query cache, because useAppConfigFeed calls useApi and the ApiProvider sits inside AppProviders' children; a second useQuery observer would also overwrite the query's options (its queryFn is what the offline probe refetches). No request is added. AppNoticeGate.tsx and appNotices.ts are untouched. Edge: readAppNotices takes new Date() per render, so at the exact moment a planned notice's time passes the two renders can disagree until AppNoticeGate re-renders.

- M2 NOT DONE: the Edit to eslint.config.mjs was refused by the local ecc config-protection PreToolUse hook ('Modifying eslint.config.mjs is not allowed'). I did not work around the hook, so webVersion.ts still calls globalThis.fetch and lint passes. To finish M2, someone allowed past that hook adds after the src/api/http.ts block: { files: ["src/platform/webVersion.ts"], rules: { "no-restricted-syntax": "off" } }, and changes webVersion.ts loadFromOrigin to (path, init) => fetch(path, init).
- L1 fixed: 30 s gap after the last finished check for focus/visibility wakes; the 5-minute interval is unchanged.
- L4 fixed: .catch logs with console.error (allowed by lint; RouteErrorBoundary precedent), then .finally clears the in-flight flag and stamps the time.
- L3 fixed: location = /version.json sends Cache-Control: no-cache.
- L2, L5, L6 left as the coordinator asked; DEPLOY.md untouched (coordinator adds the suggested text).
- Tests: no new tests. The two browser watch tests now advance a mocked Date.now past the 30 s gap between wakes (intentional behaviour change).
RUNS ON fccf097
- red 1014f290 (comparison always current: 2 fail), red fec407ab (native skip removed: 2 fail); restored and cmp-identical.

- green: contracts 9d1dde47; frontend check 3c3b4db3 (63 files, 568 tests, boots 61, phonepe passed); build:client fd5e8499 (72 assets 1049026 B); build:admin 122513cc (boots 93); build:android 2d1bcd36; build:android:admin 0e57b775 (105 assets 1417579 B, phonepe passed).

- evidence 757b4df3: image built and run hardened; / , /index.html, /users/<id>, /version.json no-cache; /assets/*.js and .woff2 immutable; missing asset 404; /health unchanged; ETag 304. Test image and container removed.
- Earlier runs on 3dcc4e3 stay recorded (reds 8d0c62aa, 4e2ff829; greens b0a2317a, 400626ce, f1aa7179, dd7e5dce, d2caadfc, cfab996d; evidence 153ebdca).

COMPATIBILITY (rule 11): no API, contract, schema or data change; the APKs never fetch version.json; older tabs pick up the build on their next reload; an image rollback makes open tabs offer Reload into the rolled-back build.
LEFT: Button sm is 36 px at lg (primitive's compact size); client Reload never asks (no client held-write registry); a removed lazy chunk now 404s.
RUNTIME STEPS FOR THE COORDINATOR

1. After the dev deploy: curl -sI https://beonedge-vps.tail4ea2bc.ts.net/ , .../users/x and .../version.json -> Cache-Control: no-cache; curl -sI .../assets/app-<hash>.js (name from the page source) -> public, max-age=31536000, immutable; curl -s .../version.json -> deployed label, target admin. Same on https://dev-app.beonedge.in with target client.

2. Open admin web, sign in, stay on a page; the maintainer deploys a newer build; switch away for more than 30 s and back. Expect a slate banner 'A newer version of BeOnEdge is available.' with Reload (44 px at phone width) above the admin top bar. Reload brings the new build; Account shows the new App version.

3. Held write: block one admin write's URL in DevTools, submit so it shows Not confirmed, unblock, wait for the offline banner to clear (probe every 10 s). Reload opens 'Reload now?' with Stay and Reload anyway.

4. One banner at a time: with the version banner showing, publish an app config with a planned maintenance notice (maintenance.message plus a future scheduledFor) and refocus after the config refetch: the notice banner shows alone; clear the notice: the version banner returns. DevTools Offline: the connectivity banner shows alone.
5. On a current build, block /version.json and refocus after 30 s: no banner and no offline banner.
6. APK (client and admin): chrome://inspect Network shows no /version.json request and no banner after resume.
Commit: 3dcc4e3 fix(web): revalidate index.html and offer Reload for a newer build (one commit, track/p-web-version, not landed).
WHAT CHANGED

- frontend_stack_ts/nginx.conf: location = /index.html sends Cache-Control: no-cache; / and the SPA fallback reach it through index/try_files internal redirects. location /assets/ sends public, max-age=31536000, immutable and uses try_files $uri =404, so a missing asset is a 404 and HTML is never cached under an asset name (add_header without always skips 404). / and /health unchanged. The container config had no server-level add_header, and the image's http-level nginx.conf adds none (curl shows none).

- Host proxies (release_manager/nginx, read only, not edited): admin.tailscale.conf / -> :47422, dev-app -> :47421, app.beonedge.in -> :47411, admin-prod -> :47412 are plain proxy_pass with no proxy_hide_header Cache-Control, proxy_ignore_headers, proxy_cache or expires (only the maintenance page has expires -1). Their server-level add_header are the security snippet and X-Robots-Tag, which do not touch Cache-Control. So the container's Cache-Control passes through (STATIC).

- vite.config.ts: build-only plugin beo-version-manifest emits dist/version.json {"version":<validated appVersion>,"target":"client"|"admin"}. dist root only, so check-android-dist (reads dist/assets) is unaffected.

- src/platform/webVersion.ts: compareDeployedBuild (tolerant z.object so a later manifest with extra keys still works; target must match; version string equality -> current / replaced / unknown). watchWebVersion: skipped when isNative() or the https://localhost WebView origin (isNativeShell); otherwise checks on start, focus, visibilitychange and every 5 min while not hidden, one read in flight, 10 s abort, fetch cache no-store; any failure or malformed body reports nothing.

- src/app/native/WebVersionBanner.tsx: NOTICE_BANNER + flex row, role=status, copy 'A newer version of BeOnEdge is available.' + Button secondary sm 'Reload'. Hidden while degraded (the offline banner wins, the same rule AppNoticeGate uses). Reload = window.location.reload(); with useHasUnsettledHeldWrite() it opens ConfirmDialog 'Reload now?' (Stay / Reload anyway, danger); the dialog closes if the write settles.
- AppProviders.tsx: two lines (import + <WebVersionBanner /> after <ConnectivityBanner />).

WHY the https://localhost skip: check-bundle-boots renders the app in JSDOM at https://localhost and exits only when the event loop empties; my first build hung there on the 5-minute setInterval (killed after ~10 min). The APK origin is https://localhost too, so it doubles as a second native guard.

COMPATIBILITY (rule 11): no API, contract, schema or data change. version.json is a new static file. Released APKs never fetch it. Tabs of 0.18.2 or earlier have no watcher and pick the new build up on their next reload. Rolling back the images (0.18.2 / v0.17.0) restores the old nginx.conf without Cache-Control; open tabs of this build then see another version and offer Reload into the rolled-back build, which is what is wanted.

TESTS: src/platform/webVersion.test.ts, 13 tests (comparison incl. rollback, extra keys, 7 unknown shapes; native skip via bridge and via origin; browser reads uncached on start and focus; silent failures).

- red 8d0c62aa (runner 20261118T074814Z-350556): compareDeployedBuild always current -> 2 fail. red 4e2ff829 (20261118T074828Z-356264): native skip removed -> 2 fail. Restored and cmp-identical each time.
CHECKS (head 3dcc4e3, clean tree, Node 24 container):
- contracts npm ci && npm run build: green b0a2317a.
- frontend npm ci && npm run check: green 400626ce, 63 files, 568 tests; check-bundle-boots 61 chunks; check-phonepe-native-target passed.

- build:client f1aa7179 (check-android-dist client 72 assets 1048665 B; boots 61 chunks); build:admin dd7e5dce (boots 93); build:android d2caadfc; build:android:admin cfab996d (admin 105 assets 1417218 B; boots 93; phonepe passed).

- evidence 153ebdca: frontend image built from frontend_stack_ts/Dockerfile (admin, 0.18.3-dev.1), run with --read-only --cap-drop ALL no-new-privileges tmpfs /tmp as runtime_contract.test.sh does. curl -I: / , /index.html and /users/<id> 200 Cache-Control: no-cache; /assets/index-*.js and a .woff2 200 public, max-age=31536000, immutable; /assets/app-missing.js 404 without Cache-Control; /version.json 200 application/json {"version":"0.18.3-dev.1","target":"admin"}; /health 200 unchanged; conditional GET of / with its ETag 304. Test image and container removed; the pinned node and nginx base images pulled for it stay in the local Docker cache.
DOUBTFUL / LEFT:

- Lint: no-restricted-syntax forbids a bare fetch() outside src/api/http.ts. webVersion.ts calls globalThis.fetch, because version.json is a static file of the web host and must not go through the API transport or report to the offline banner. Lint passes; if the coordinator prefers it explicit, add an eslint override for src/platform/webVersion.ts like the http.ts one (eslint.config.mjs is outside this lane).

- Docs (rule 18; DEPLOY.md is outside this lane): suggested addition after the VITE_BEO_APP_VERSION paragraph: 'The build also writes dist/version.json with the version and target. The web app, never the APK, reads it on focus and every five minutes and offers Reload when it differs. The frontend nginx serves index.html with Cache-Control: no-cache and /assets/ with a year immutable.'

- The version banner and the maintenance notice banner (features/app-notice/AppNoticeGate.tsx) can show together: both sticky top-0 and both write --be-chrome-offset (the finding-51 stacking class). Not fixed here.
- Button sm is 44 px below lg and 36 px at lg (the primitive's compact desktop size).
- The client app has no held-write registry, so client Reload never asks; the brief scoped the ask to admin unsettledHeldWrites.
- A tab lazy-loading a chunk that a deploy removed now gets 404 instead of index.html; both fail the import, and the banner then offers Reload.
RUNTIME STEPS FOR THE COORDINATOR (web only; no emulator step is needed beyond 5):

1. After the dev deploy: curl -sI https://beonedge-vps.tail4ea2bc.ts.net/ and .../users/x -> Cache-Control: no-cache plus the security headers and X-Robots-Tag. Take an asset name from the page source: curl -sI https://beonedge-vps.tail4ea2bc.ts.net/assets/app-<hash>.js -> Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable. curl -s https://beonedge-vps.tail4ea2bc.ts.net/version.json -> {"version":"<deployed label>","target":"admin"}. Same on https://dev-app.beonedge.in with target client.

2. Open admin web on that build, sign in, stay on any page; the maintainer deploys a newer dev build; switch to another tab or app and back. Expect within a second a slate banner at the very top: 'A newer version of BeOnEdge is available.' and a Reload button (44 px tall at phone width); the admin top bar sits below it. Tap Reload: the page reloads, the banner is gone, Account shows the new App version.

3. Held write: before step 2's Reload, in DevTools block the request URL of one admin write, submit it so it shows Not confirmed, then unblock. Tap Reload: dialog 'Reload now?' with Stay and Reload anyway. Stay keeps the page and the held save; Reload anyway reloads.

4. With the banner showing, set DevTools Network to Offline: the connectivity banner replaces it; back online, the version banner returns. Blocking /version.json in DevTools shows no banner and no offline banner.
5. APK (client and admin): chrome://inspect -> Network shows no /version.json request and no banner after resume.
